_help: Copy to config.json (gitignored) or use Settings in the app, which writes it. 'engines' lists the crispz family tools Dataset Studio drives through the CLI protocol v1: 'url' = the app instance (hidden Gradio endpoints cli_caps / cli_edit / cli_faces), 'dir' = its install folder so Dataset Studio can START it when nothing answers (the port of 'url' is passed as GRADIO_SERVER_PORT, the log goes to logs/<name>.log), 'launch' = allow that start, 'python' = optional explicit interpreter (default: <dir>/.venv, then <dir>/env, then py -3). Give each engine ITS OWN port: two family apps on 7860 cannot coexist, and two running at once do not fit on one GPU anyway (Dataset Studio starts one at a time). 'engine' = the default. 'ollama' = the local vision model used when a project's caption_source is 'ollama' or 'both' (empty model = first installed; keep_alive 0 unloads it after each caption, the GPU is shared with the engine).
